title: SEO and search
summary: Route an SEO request to the smallest verified function Skill that owns the requested deliverable.
outcome: One explicit choice between opportunity mapping and evidence-led content briefing, with the selected function Skill loaded before execution.
boundary: The router does not run catalog tools, combine workflows without a new checkpoint, provide continuous tracking, publish content or promise rankings.

catalog_tools.purpose: Used only after routing to SEO Opportunity Map.
Used only after routing to SEO Opportunity Map.
Used only after routing to a selected SEO function Skill.
Used only after routing to SEO Content Brief.

inputs: The SEO outcome or deliverable the user wants
Any supplied target domain, market, audience or selected topic
outputs: One selected verified function Skill and a concise reason
A clear boundary when no verified function Skill owns the request

cost.model: Routing is agent-side and makes no paid call.
cost.notes: The selected function Skill presents and obtains approval for its own paid plan.

approvals: Ask before installing or updating a missing function Skill; paid approvals belong to the selected function Skill
compatibility: The selected function Skill installed from the same pinned repository revision
